_meta.note: BSH (Bosch/Siemens/Neff) identifier layer expressed in the common model. Stress test: BSH uses E-Nr (base + /xx revision) -> document -> signature -> scheme. Reuses existing BSH data; no re-collection.

identifierStructure.eNr: E-Nr (Enumber): model/product family identifier, e.g. SMV4HVX32E/01. Base = SMV4HVX32E; /01 = revision (FD/index).
identifierStructure.base: E_NR_BASE identifies the model/product family and (via document/signature) the code scheme.
identifierStructure.revision: E_NR_REVISION (/xx): production index / service revision. Behaves like Electrolux ELC - metadata; NO evidence it changes error-code MEANING (scheme is set by the base/document). Treat as revision metadata, not scheme-affecting.

evidence.reference: E-Nr + FD on rating plate; /xx index

eNrToSchemeMechanism: E-Nr base -> official service document -> normalized code table -> signature -> scheme cluster (BSH document->scheme work). This is the same identifier-layer flow (observed identifier -> canonical -> resolvedAttributes.scheme).

dw_registers.problem: DW legacy E:NN vs new E:NN-NN are different registers (e.g. filters-blocked = E:22 legacy vs E:92-40 new)
